summary: After an illegal strike, a union faces a large court fine and some parents say their trust in the teachers has dropped.
realLife: After a two-week teachers' strike in Newton, Massachusetts, in 2024, the union was fined $625,000 and the settlement raised pay about 12.6 percent over four years.
sources: Boston Globe, Newton strike ends: winners and losers: https://www.bostonglobe.com/2024/02/03/metro/newton-strike-ends-update-winners-losers/
inGame: strike formed by the public-action engine ends; the settlement changes teacher pay on job records; parent ties to teachers can cool.
